scope: Issuer-announced financial release schedules and completion of the uncached financial comparison review.

There is no separately dated quarterly earnings release or exact quarterly diluted EPS in these sources.

ECHO|2026-09-30.disposition: The issuer-hosted quarterly report confirms the filed results. The same-day current report does not announce these quarterly results.

TXT|2026-01-03.disposition: The fact book confirms the release’s $1.33 continuing-operations diluted EPS. The consolidated income in the release is $235 million, rounded to the nearest million. At approximately 177.125 million diluted shares, the feasible range straddles $1.325, so the consolidated quarter EPS cannot be inferred to the cent.

DELL.basis: Dell will issue its fiscal 2027 third-quarter results by press release before its November 24 conference call. The announcement gives the call time of 3:30 p.m. Central and gives no separate release time.

NKE.basis: Nike schedules the fiscal 2027 second-quarter release for about 1:15 p.m. Pacific after the regular close. The call follows at 2 p.m. Pacific.
